plan.title: Offline updates and parent save tools

narratives.Overview: Add offline-first support and a hidden parent-only control surface for save export/import, while allowing the app to check for updated content in the background whenever internet is available.
narratives.Requirements: FR-1: After first load, the game can run normally without internet access. FR-2: When internet is available, the app checks for updates in the background and adopts newer assets without blocking play. FR-3: If no internet is available, the game continues normal play using cached assets. FR-4: Parent-only controls allow export and import of save data as a file. FR-5: Parent controls are hidden behind a child-resistant gesture instead of an obvious button. NFR-1: Update checks must fail gracefully with no child-facing error state. NFR-2: Save export/import should be simple enough for a parent to use on a Fire tablet browser.
narratives.Traces: Implements FR-1 through FR-5 and NFR-1 through NFR-2.
